name: Stripe Payments
summary: A developer-focused global payments platform for cards, wallets, bank methods, hosted checkout, payment links, and custom payment flows.

pricing.headline: US standard pricing starts at 2.9% + $0.30 for domestic online cards; country, method, international, and FX fees vary.
pricing.assumptions: US domestic online card. International cards add 1.5%, currency conversion adds 1%, a received dispute costs $15, and manually countering it can add another $15 that is returned on a win.

sellerCoverage: Businesses must be based in a Stripe-supported country or region.
buyerCoverage: Supported Stripe businesses can sell to buyers globally, subject to sanctions, product, currency, and payment-method rules.
products: Broad online business coverage subject to Stripe's prohibited and restricted-business policies.

features.checkout: Stripe Checkout, Elements, Payment Links, mobile SDKs, and direct APIs.
features.subscriptions: Available through the separately priced Stripe Billing product.
features.invoicing: Available through Stripe Invoicing, with separate pricing for paid invoices and optional features.
features.paymentMethods: Cards, wallets, bank debits and transfers, BNPL, vouchers, and local methods by market.
features.payouts: Rolling, weekly, monthly, and eligible instant payout options vary by country.

responsibilities.note: Stripe processes the payment; the business sells to the buyer.
Stripe Tax can assist, but ordinary Payments does not transfer seller liability.
Stripe supplies tools and workflows; the merchant bears transaction and dispute responsibility.
The business supports its buyers unless it uses a separate service.

strengths: Many payment methods and integration surfaces
Modular billing, tax, and reporting products
limitations: The merchant retains tax and compliance responsibility
Add-on and cross-border fees can materially change the headline rate
Billing and advanced revenue tools are separate products
bestFor: Companies prepared to own tax and payment operations
avoidIf: You want another company to be the legal seller
Your business country is not supported
